context.trader: One trader, one year, one notebook
rules: Starter positions are a quarter of a full position. A full position is only taken after it moves in my favour.
I do not chase. If the pullback does not come, I do not take the trade.
Targets and stops are written before entry and I do not move them.
The journal is written the same evening, before I know what the next day does.
context.note: Invented trades and invented notes, written the way a journal is written: short, sometimes defensive, occasionally wrong about what happened.
